name: 01-tab-short-heading
title: Short heading
use: Short stage names such as Think, Pair or Share.

name: 02-tab-medium-heading
title: Medium heading
use: Headings such as Your turn or Key idea.

name: 03-tab-long-heading
title: Long heading
use: Longer headings such as Listening challenge.

name: 04-tab-wide-heading
title: Wide heading
use: A full activity title spanning a wide pane.

name: 05-tab-page-banner
title: Page banner
use: A large title tab for the top of a slide or several panes.

name: 06-tab-two-line-heading
title: Two line heading
use: Two short lines, with room for a readable stage subtitle.

name: 07-tab-wide-two-line
title: Wide two line
use: A longer two-line title or a heading plus a brief instruction.

name: 08-tab-bottom-edge-tab
title: Bottom edge tab
use: Attach to a lower edge for a short takeaway or answer label.

name: 09-tab-side-flag
title: Side flag
use: Place on a side edge for a prompt, hint or group label.

name: 10-tab-footer-label
title: Footer label
use: A short answer, reminder or exit-ticket message.

name: 11-pane-small-note
title: Small note
use: One short prompt, quotation or example.

name: 12-pane-wide-caption
title: Wide caption
use: A brief instruction, model answer or definition.

name: 13-pane-medium-square
title: Medium square
use: A question, picture or short set of notes.

name: 14-pane-tall-portrait
title: Tall portrait
use: A speaking role, longer prompt or individual task.

name: 15-pane-landscape-pane
title: Landscape pane
use: An activity prompt with enough room for examples.

name: 16-pane-large-feature
title: Large feature
use: The main teaching content or visual for a slide.

name: 17-pane-narrow-sidebar
title: Narrow sidebar
use: Vocabulary, roles, keywords or compact reminders.

name: 18-pane-long-footer
title: Long footer
use: A full-width answer reveal, recap or exit ticket.

name: 19-pane-angled-pane
title: Angled pane
use: A debate viewpoint, contrasting idea or action beat.

name: 20-pane-speech-pane
title: Speech pane
use: A character utterance, interview question or model response.
